_doc: Where each character's harvest trips start and end (docs/LUMBER_LOOP.md §3; harness/home.py). The way home is the character's own book's default rune, which lands at `landing` (facet `facet`); from there the house steward or innkeeper takes it into the rental room `room` (owner words for the room menu's Visit Other Rooms row; empty = the character's own room), on facet `room.facet`. The boards go into the room's Resource Stockpile `stockpile` (harness/stockpile.py) when the home has one, else into the secure container `chest` (within reach of `room.arrival`); spent trapped pouches always go into `chest`. `library` is the rune library at home (places.py; the Cambria library is public and always usable). Live values: docs/NOTES.md 'Rental room via the DTF house steward' (2026-10-04) and 'Resource Stockpile' (2026-10-05).

dropoff._doc: harness/dropoff.py, `ctl act dropoff`: the user's Razor script 'New Drop Off' (Scripts/New Drop Off.razor, F5), step for step; entries are clilocs (1095566 Add All In Backpack, 1095568 Add All Unidentified Items From Backpack, 3006349 Restock, 3006348 Resupply). Names: click labels in capture 20261015_210709; [INFERENCE] where only the server's first reply words were captured. Then `to_chest` from the pack's top level into `chest` (user 2026-10-15: research materials and resource maps, 'chest for now, we'll buy tomes later'; resource maps by name, their graphic not seen yet).
